display_name: 恢复器源域可观测性诊断：延迟、边界、相位与弱频谱
description: 不新增训练，不读取TX/F输出或目标；全L/U重复结构统计及既有1800源V六信道和U-Net恢复误差分解，为下一版机制提供源证据。
authorization: 本对话2026-10-19用户要求独立无监督恢复网络、覆盖IQ/FFT/PAMF输入、尝试多种设计含扩散、使用L/U；提供恢复器报告；最新明确训练默认N607并允许多GPU快速验证，直接接训练好F验证真实输入TX身份。

data.version: original validated source physical split; no resplit
data.representation: equalized=1, center256, original packet RMS; practical residual/post_sync/noeq at25MHz
data.physical_ids_ref: same contract#role_ids; V panel chosen perRX/day without TX labels using fixed data seed
data.label_map_ref: source_cache/manifest.json#class_id_to_tx; label files read only by independent scorer
data.tx_sets_ref: all original six TX; restoration training uses no TX labels
data.validation_ref: source_cache/manifest.json: READY/EXACT_MATCH; reuse existing cache without new data validation
data.leo_config_ref: experiments/pamf_restoration/data.py: six practical residual/noEQ/fixed one source training draw per physical ID

target_panel.selection: uniform physical-ID panel; source-selected single candidate only; new six practical paired diagnostics, not historical satellite observations

permissions.regime: Source waveform diagnostic only; no TX label/F output/target access; no parameter update
permissions.claim_scope: Nominal latency and source received-only boundary controls; no claim of transmitter identity or exact lost-information rank

checkpoint.initialization: No new model; analyze existing source-only U-Net predictions, no checkpoint loading
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: existing cleanF E200 and AsF T1 E20+10 source_contract and complete scratch-parent lineage; exact local source roles matched; frozen.py
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: F checkpoints VERIFIED: cleanF scratch E200/defaulthead; AsF scratch20+own10/defaulthead. Restoration inherits no weights; fixed F used only for post-freeze evaluation.
checkpoint.selection_rule: No candidate selection or target scoring in this diagnostic

execution.host: Local CPU; read-only N607 source artifact retrieval
execution.stop_rule: Output conflict, nonfinite waveform, mismatching source ID set or missing original source artifact aborts; no target fallback.

metric_names: known24-shift controls with zero/reflect/received-only periodic boundary
low/high power FFT quartile relative error with denominator floor
metrics_plan.primary: Explain common waveform error components; no identity/model-qualification claims

rows.seed_notes: split is original contract; data seed fixes source V panel and native source scene/noise draw; augmentation fixes receiver sessions/clean mask and training diffusion/flow RNG; support not applicable; target panel seed separately fixed.
rows.budget_ref: Zero optimization; full6300L+56700U autocorrelation; fixed1800 source V x clean+six native views and existing U-Net outputs.

notes: Original seven-network fixed matrix remains complete and unchanged; no budget expansion or multi-seed promotion.
Known scene appears only in diagnostic grouping. Fixed shift controls cannot become a deployable clean/augmented router using scene labels.
Oracle gain/phase uses clean solely for source diagnosis and is never a restoration output.
L/U IQ inputs and sourceV membership reuse validated source cache; no data revalidation; no target artifact downloads.
Next mechanism must be justified by source diagnostics; previous target outcomes cannot tune or select it.
